name: Vogel Computer Centre
story: The Vogel Computer Centre grew from the Ministry of Works’ specialist computing section, established in 1966. By 1980 it provided engineering and scientific computing for public-sector work, including calculations where engineers needed to compare many route and terrain alternatives.

sources.label: A. C. Shailes, “The impact of computers on the public sector” (1980), ITPNZ history
